controles.affirmation: Le premier client a acheté 7 796,7 M€, soit 23,9% des ventes 2025, contre 16,6% en 2024 ; 38,0% pour les deux premiers
controles.verbatim_source: Total net sales to our largest customer amounted to EUR7,796.7 million, or 23.9% of total net sales in 2025, compared with EUR4,682.4 million, or 16.6% of total net sales in 2024. In 2025, 38.0% of total net sales were made to our two largest customers. (20-F FY2025)

controles.affirmation: Quatre clients dépassent chacun 10% des ventes, total 20,0 Mds € soit 61,2% du CA
controles.verbatim_source: In 2025, four customers each individually exceeded 10% of total net sales, totaling EUR20.0 billion, or 61.2%, of total net sales. (20-F FY2025)

controles.affirmation: Quantitatif perspective : quatre clients >10% en 2025 contre deux clients seulement en 2023 (53,9%)
controles.verbatim_source: In 2024 four customers and in 2023, two customers exceeded 10% of total net sales, in 2024 totaling EUR15.2 billion, or 53.8% (2023: EUR14.9 billion, or 53.9%).
controles.correction_proposee: Chiffres exacts, mais la comparaison saute 2024 où quatre clients dépassaient déjà 10% (53,8%). Mentionner 2024 éviterait de suggérer un passage de 2 à 4 clients en un an.

controles.affirmation: Carl Zeiss SMT est fournisseur unique des optiques, sous accord d'exclusivité, et plafonne la production d'ASML
controles.verbatim_source: The number of lithography systems we are able to produce is limited by the production capacity of one of our key suppliers, Carl Zeiss SMT, our sole supplier of lenses, mirrors, illuminators, collectors and other critical optical components (which we refer to as optics). We have an exclusive arrangement with Carl Zeiss SMT. If this supplier became unable to maintain and increase production levels, we could be unable to fulfill orders.

controles.affirmation: Licences d'exportation exigées pour EUV et DUV immersion ; les changements de contrôles peuvent avoir un impact significatif sur volume, mix et calendrier des ventes
controles.verbatim_source: we are required to secure export licenses for EUV systems, specific DUV immersion systems, and some of our other products / Changes in export controls may have a material impact on our business for example on the sales volume, mix and timing.

controles.affirmation: Contrôles néerlandais élargis le 15 janvier 2025, UE en novembre 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Effective January 15, 2025, the Netherlands expanded its export control regulations to include an additional group of semiconductor manufacturing equipment / EU Export Controls: In November 2025, the European Union incorporated certain Dutch national controls...

controles.affirmation: Terres rares : restrictions chinoises suspendues un an, jusqu'au 10 novembre 2026 ; aucun impact matériel à date
controles.verbatim_source: China has suspended its export restrictions on rare earth materials for one year, until November 10, 2026 / To date, no material impact on customers has been observed.
controles.correction_proposee: Le filing dit précisément 'no material impact on customers has been observed' (impact sur les clients), l'ATT généralise en 'aucun impact matériel'. Nuance mineure.

controles.verbatim_source: 6-K 28/01/2026 : 'expects 2026 total net sales to be between EUR34 billion and EUR39 billion' ; 6-K 15/04/2026 : 'between EUR36 billion and EUR40 billion' ; 6-K 15/07/2026 : 'between EUR43 billion and EUR45 billion, with a gross margin between 54% and 56%'.
